$comment: Copy this file to config.json and paste your Provider-API key into apiKey. Create and manage the key at https://commandcode.ai/settings/keys . config.json must never be committed.
$comment_language: Interface language: en, it, zh, or auto to follow the operating system. Default: en.
$comment_profiles: To monitor several accounts, list them here instead of using apiKey. Each entry needs an id (lower-case letters, digits, hyphens, unique) and its own key: apiKey inline, or apiKeyEnv naming an environment variable. activeProfile picks the account the tray icon follows; the Account menu switches it at runtime. Leaving this list empty keeps the single-account behaviour above. Example: [{ "id": "personal", "name": "Personal", "apiKey": "user_..." }, { "id": "work", "name": "Work", "apiKeyEnv": "COMMANDCODE_API_KEY_WORK" }]
$comment_endpoints: The /alpha surface is not publicly documented: if Command Code changes it, fix the paths here without touching the code.
$comment_refresh: Background polling interval. Opening the bubble never waits: it reads the last known value immediately and replaces it when the new one arrives.
$comment_thresholds: Percentage thresholds used for the icon and bar colours.
$comment_ui: iconMetric chooses which window the icon ring follows: fiveHour, weekly or monthly. The dot always tracks the weekly window.
$comment_creditFiles: Alternative credential sources (read only, never written). Used only when apiKey and COMMANDCODE_API_KEY are empty.
